data.narrative:
Intramotev is a Series A autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $14.4M to date. The broader comp universe includes 8 private peers in this sector (notably Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro), though no public comparables exist. Identifying sufficiently similar peers at the same stage proved challenging; only one adjacent-stage comparable was identified, making traditional peer-median analysis inapplicable.

Given data constraints, the analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $14M raised proxy—a typical Series A to subsequent-stage progression rate. This method yields an implied valuation of $29M. The triangulation range, incorporating conservative and upside variants around this single applicable method, spans $24M (low) to $33M (high), with $29M as the central estimate.

The key uncertainty is the applicability of the 2.0x multiplier to this specific company without peer validation. Intramotev's actual position within the sector maturity spectrum and capital efficiency relative to the broader comp set remain opaque. A narrower valuation range would require either identifying additional same-stage Drones & Autonomous peers or obtaining revenue/unit economics data to anchor a revenue or earnings multiple approach. The $24M–$33M range should be treated as preliminary pending such additional diligence.
